# Codex Navo

> Codex Navo is an independent, unofficial, open-source Windows workspace for managing multiple Codex accounts. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

Codex Navo provides isolated Chrome profiles and Codex OAuth authorization for standard accounts, quota and token monitoring, an OpenAI-compatible local API account pool with automatic failover, per-account and per-key proxy routing, project and session management, notifications, and a configurable floating status window.

## Authoritative links

- Project website: https://1080ssf.github.io/codex-navo/

- API guide: https://github.com/1080ssf/codex-navo/blob/main/docs/api-service.md
- Issues: https://github.com/1080ssf/codex-navo/issues

## Core capabilities

- Multi-account isolation and one-click Codex authorization switching on Windows
- Quota, input, cached input, output, cache-rate, model-call, and token-estimate monitoring
- OpenAI-compatible `/v1/models`, `/v1/responses`, and `/v1/chat/completions` endpoints
- Ordered API account pools with cooldown and automatic failover for eligible failures
- Per-account and per-API-key proxy routing with subscription and single-node support
- Local Codex project, session, archive, failure, and task-status management
- Windows and external-channel notifications plus a configurable floating status window
